whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Vijay Hotel,

I noticed your hotel has built a solid presence with 383+ reviews near Golambar in Patna, but currently lacks a dedicated mobile booking website for direct guest inquiries.

Maine aapke hotel ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp room booking, dining menu, aur location directions integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/vijay

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Vijay Hotel, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business (Vijay Hotel at Golambar, Patna) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp room booking and your prime Patna location highlights. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki actual room photos, pricing aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
